newsitem.title: INDIA: ICICI to sell 25 pct stake in ICICI Bank.
newsitem.headline: ICICI to sell 25 pct stake in ICICI Bank.

text.p: The Industrial Credit and Investment Corporation of India will offer for sale 25 percent of its stake in ICICI Banking Corporation, an ICICI official said on Thursday.
ICICI will make a public sale offer of 41.25 million shares of 10 rupees at a premium of 25 per share, Lalita Gupte, ICICI executive director told a news conference.
The offer is open from August 5 till August 11, she said.
ICICI Bank, established in 1994, is one of a new breed of private sector banks set up after the Reserve Bank of India liberalised norms for starting new banks.
The bank has 24 branches and two extension counters and plans to open 18 more offices during 1997/98 (April-March), it said in a statement.
It reported a net profit of 401.3 million rupees for the year ended March 31, 1997 against 171.1 million the previous year.
Deposits were 13.48 billion rupees against 7.3 billion in the corresponding period while advances were 7.98 billion rupees compared to 6.51 billion, the bank said.
